errors.description: The displayed product calculation is incorrect: since lcm(m,n)=mn/g, the new entries have product mn/g, not mn/g². The immediately following conclusion P'=P/g is nevertheless correct, so this is a local, straightforwardly repairable algebraic error.

parsed.notes: Apart from this typo, the lexicographic descent proves termination and the primewise gcd-of-valuations invariant correctly determines the unique terminal value.
